items.title: DHI Q3 deep dive: affordability pressures and incentives shape outlook as margins compress
items.summary: Homebuilder D.R. Horton (NYSE:DHI) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026), but sales fell by 3.2% year on year to $9.37 billion. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $31 billion at the midpoint came in 7.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.67 per share was 10.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
